en: Monochrome view inside a large glass-and-iron pavilion or hall, with ornate cast-iron columns and tall arched windows. At the center is a circular basin with a strong vertical jet of water like a thermal or mineral fountain. Elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion, including women with large hats and men with bowler and boater hats, stand and walk around the fountain, some apparently drinking or collecting water. The scene suggests a fashionable spa or pump room in a European resort town.
